summary: Tighten deterministic RFI and Submittal identifiers and let a reviewer explicitly import one inert EML attachment with parent-email provenance through the existing upload controls.
decision_refs: User request to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and email content
User /ponytail instruction to prefer open-source and existing code over new infrastructure
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requests continued RFI, Submittal and email improvements and invokes /ponytail for minimal reuse.
known_limitations: Only RFC-style EML files are supported; MSG and mailbox synchronization remain unsupported.
Attachments and nested attached emails require explicit user selection; bulk or automatic recursive import is not implemented.
Only deterministic digit-bearing identifiers and explicit statuses are normalized; semantic relationship and authority adjudication remain human review tasks.
Validation uses synthetic local email and workflow documents only; no customer file, external provider or paid model call was used.
